mapper.select: SELECT id,type_code typeCode,name,status,description,sort_order sortOrder FROM showcase_shop_type WHERE status='ENABLED' ORDER BY sort_order,id

SELECT r.shop_id shopId,t.id,t.type_code typeCode,t.name,t.status FROM showcase_shop_type_rel r JOIN showcase_shop_type t ON t.type_code=r.type_code WHERE r.shop_id IN #{id} ORDER BY t.sort_order,t.id
SELECT id,owner_username ownerUsername,status FROM showcase_shop WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,type_code typeCode,name,status FROM showcase_shop_type WHERE type_code IN #{code} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.id,t.type_code typeCode,t.name FROM showcase_shop_type t JOIN showcase_shop_type_rel r ON r.type_code=t.type_code WHERE r.shop_id=#{shopId} AND t.type_code=#{typeCode}t.id=#{typeId} AND t.status='ENABLED' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE showcase_product p SET p.status='OFFLINE' WHERE p.shop_id=#{id} AND p.status='PUBLISHED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM showcase_shop_type_rel r JOIN showcase_shop_type t ON t.type_code=r.type_code WHERE r.shop_id=p.shop_id AND t.id=p.type_id)
mapper.select: SELECT shop_id FROM showcase_product WHERE id=#{id}
